description: Defines the 'Todo' class representing a task item with fields for id, title, subtitle, completion status, creation, and update timestamps. Includes methods for copying, serialization/deserialization to/from map, and equality checks.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Represents a Todo item with properties such as id, title, subtitle, completion status, createdAt, and updatedAt. Provides utility methods for copying, serialization, and comparison.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Todo with optional overridden fields.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Todo object into a Map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Todo instance from a Map (e.g., database row).
